lines.text: Meet Sam. He found the perfect bike online... from a total stranger.
But who pays first? Pay upfront, and the bike might never show. And Ana? She's seen fake payment screenshots before.
Sam locks the money in one tap. Ana sees it's real, locked on Stellar. They meet, Sam scans her code... and she's paid.
No signal? Still works. It's right inside Vinted and OLX. And Claude or ChatGPT can set it all up... but never touch your money.
Cars, flats, parcels... even your event crew, paid the moment they check in.
SHAKE. Pay a stranger, only when you meet.
